What you’ll learn

On This Free Webinar You’ll Discover…

Secret#1

The Signals You Already See

Growth, hiring, a new location, a tight month. You’ll learn to spot the moments a business owner may need capital, from conversations you’re already having, so you reach them before they go to their bank or a stranger online, and you become the person they’re glad they told.

Secret#2

The One Sentence

No rates, no approvals, no lending advice. You’ll get one short, natural sentence that opens the funding conversation, so it feels like help instead of a pitch. Your reputation stays intact, and offering funding becomes something you can do comfortably with every business owner you know.

Secret#3

Match → Mention → Get Paid

Match a business owner you know to a funding need, then mention it in one sentence. LendTrack’s funding team handles the file, so there’s no paperwork or underwriting on your desk. When an introduction funds, you get paid, and the relationships you already have start working for you in a new way.

Meet your host

Who Is Oz Konar?

Your host for this free webinar.

Before he had a company of his own, Oz was a sales consultant in New York City, selling financing products and working sixty to seventy hours a week. One day his wife asked him if they’d ever have dinner together again.

That question got him out. He started a marketing agency that ended up serving merchant cash advance and alternative lending companies. Later, when he was doing loan brokerage himself, he built that business through referral partners: people business owners already trusted.

That’s the idea behind The Match Method: you match and mention, LendTrack’s funding team handles the file, and the introduction is tracked instead of disappearing. On this webinar, Oz walks you through all three steps.

Oz has been featured in Forbes, Entrepreneur and deBanked.

Is this for you?

This Free Webinar Is For You If…

  • You work with business owners, or you simply know a lot of them: as a CPA, bookkeeper, consultant, coach, insurance or financial professional, realtor or vendor.
  • You already know business owners who are growing, hiring or short on cash.
  • You’d like to help them get funded, without becoming a lender, underwriting a deal or doing the paperwork.
  • You’re open to getting paid when an introduction funds, under a signed partner agreement.
